text: every message. Every payment. Every song you stream.
Something is orchestrating all of this.
It finds a machine. Pulls your image. Starts your app. And keeps it running.
This is Kubernetes. A control plane that watches every machine in your cluster.
Your app breaks. Kubernetes restarts it.
A node dies. Kubernetes moves it.
You describe what you want. Kubernetes makes it real, and keeps it that way.
Traffic always finds a healthy pod.
Thousands of machines. Countless containers. One system.
Kubernetes. The operating system of the cloud.
And it's open source. Built in the open, by thousands of contributors.
